releaseName: Direct Clock + Version + Smooth Supporters Repair
message: Verdant 15.4.5 replaces the generic UI-state guards with direct ownership of the affected Main Board/iPad clock, all visible version labels, and smoother supporter scroll preservation.
notes: Supports 12/24-hour settings implemented as Toggle, TMP_Dropdown, or legacy Dropdown.
Finds Main Board and iPad roots from VerdantBoard/VerdantTablet components when available.
Detaches old clock/time text references from legacy scripts so they cannot overwrite the shared clock.
Updates old iPad Version 14.5 text and all other Verdant version labels to V15.4.5.
Creates a Main Board version label if one is still missing.
Replaces the every-frame supporter scroll fight with a delayed restore after layout resets to reduce stutter.
Retains the 15.4.4 assembly definitions, UdonSharp registration and VerdantRoleAuthority repair.
